websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Domains or URLs to check, one per line (for example example.com). Each site is checked once, at its homepage.

scanScripts.title: Scan scripts for WebMCP tools
scanScripts.description: Read up to six same-site script files to detect tools registered with document.modelContext.registerTool().

testCrawlerReach.title: Test crawler reach
testCrawlerReach.description: Check what AI crawlers actually get: whether a firewall or CDN turns away AI crawlers that robots.txt allows, whether the homepage content is readable without JavaScript, and whether a Markdown version is offered.

extraAiAgents.title: Extra user-agent tokens
extraAiAgents.description: Optional. Crawler tokens to check in addition to the built-in list of AI crawlers (for example a new AI bot).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt for page fetches
respectRobotsTxt.description: Fetch HTML pages only when robots.txt allows this tool (token AIReadinessAudit, falling back to *). Files published for automated readers, such as robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemaps and /.well-known files, are always read.

monitorChanges.title: Report changes since the last run
monitorChanges.description: Remember each site's result in your Apify account and add a 'changes' list on later runs. Use with a schedule to monitor sites weekly.

maxConcurrency.title: Sites checked in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites to check at the same time.
